agent.text:
I fixed both failing checks in `public/app.js`: the email check now rejects addresses without a domain ending such as "ada@example", and the Yearly toggle now shows the Grow plan at $48 per year (20% off $60). I haven't re-run anything; Handoff will run Kane again.

- **Email:** the check used to accept anything containing an "@". It now requires the address to end in a dot followed by at least two characters, so "ada@example" gets "Enter a valid email address" and no confirmation. A normal address like "you@example.com" is still accepted, so the waitlist signup check that already passes should keep passing.
- **Yearly pricing:** the yearly price was the monthly $5 × 12 with no discount. It now takes off the "save 20%" shown on the toggle button. Grow is the only paid plan on the page, so the discount covers every paid plan. I didn't add the separate automated check Kane suggested.
